convert_trunk_to_classy_model: convert a ResNet trunk state dict to Classy Vision format for a given depth
convert_heads_to_classy_model: convert an MLP head state dict to Classy Vision format with configurable FC layers and batch norm
convert_vissl_to_classy_vision: convert a VISSL ResNet model checkpoint to Classy Vision compatible format via CLI
convert_vissl_trunk_only: convert only the trunk of a VISSL model to Classy Vision format without head layers
convert_vissl_with_heads: convert a VISSL model including MLP head layers with batch norm and bias options
